description: Phase B source-adapter expansion (ROADMAP.md Phase B; ROADMAP §15 data gap). `language-range-polygons` is the ONE Phase-15 target Wikidata cannot supply — it landed at 133/200 because Wikidata carries no inline range polygons, honestly flagged in /api/data-quality. Add a NON-Wikidata source of historical/modern language-range GeoJSON (Glottolog/Ethnologue-style boundaries) to close the gap, ingested via the reusable dump adapter (106) and reconciled onto language nodes by glottocode/ISO. License-aware per source. Scope: the engine acquire layer + a range-polygon source spec + the map/geometry surface (services/api map_layers / data_quality coverage) + fixtures.

userStories.title: Ingest non-Wikidata language-range GeoJSON
userStories.description: Add a range-polygon source (historical/modern language boundaries as GeoJSON) that the 106 adapter ingests into canonical range-polygon geometry keyed to language nodes.
acceptanceCriteria: A non-Wikidata range-polygon source spec (Glottolog/Ethnologue-style GeoJSON boundaries) ingests via the 106 dump adapter into canonical language-range-polygon geometry, attached to language nodes by glottocode/ISO 639-3.
Each record carries its source + licence string (per-source, share-alike-correct where required).
A hermetic test over a small GeoJSON fixture asserts the polygons attach to the right language nodes; `uv run --all-packages pytest engine/tests` passes.

userStories.title: Move the coverage past 133/200
userStories.description: Wire the new geometry so the atlas map + the data-quality coverage report reflect the closed gap.
acceptanceCriteria: The ingested polygons surface through the map/geometry API (services/api map_layers) and the /api/data-quality coverage for language-range-polygons rises above the 133/200 baseline (or the run documents exactly how far the chosen source closes it).
The applicable gates pass: `uv run --all-packages pytest {engine,services/api}/tests`, `uv run --all-packages ruff check services/api`, `uv run --directory services/api --all-packages mypy`.
